courses.title: Sound Medicine
courses.description: A self-paced online video course, filmed in the Scottish Highlands, introducing sound healing and the use of one's own voice for balance and vitality. It covers vocal toning, a chakra toning practice, a full voice activation and deep-listening meditation, and ends with a sound journey with crystal bowls and shruti box.

left_out: The Journey of Love & Sexuality lecture series: still has no page of its own (its Enroll button on darrenaustinhall.com/courses goes to a sign-up form widget), so not restored.
flags: Sound Medicine: framed as 'self-healing' with sound and the voice (emotional balance, energy, chakras); it names Apollo as god of medicine and music but makes no claim to cure or treat a condition. Kept under the new rule.
